Return assay identifiers, target details, and publication provenance for binding assays against the hERG target. Select assay_chembl_id, tid, assay_description, target_name, target_organism, journal, year, volume, first_page, and doi. Source assays and target_dictionary. Join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter where assay_type equals 'B' and tid equals 165. Sort by assay_chembl_id, tid, journal, year, and doi.
